development_selection: Mean Top-1 across all eight curves, ties by mean Top-5 then earliest epoch
validation_protocol: 200 held-out concepts; 5 support image vectors averaged per concept, 5 separate EEG queries per concept
formal_score: Dot product: unit EEG embedding times original unnormalized center_clip templates
fit_scope: Development normalization fitted to training concepts; formal normalization fitted to the full official training partition per subject
upstream_mvnn: Published preprocessing computes session whitening from the equally weighted training and test covariances
